narrative.intro: Richard Group is a federal vendor with $65.4M in contract obligations in FY2027 to date. Richard Group has won 3 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $21.8M and obligations up 35.5% year over year. Obligations by fiscal year show variation over the last six years: FY22 $169M, FY23 $265M, FY24 $151M, FY25 $34.1M, FY26 $48.3M, FY27 $65.4M. The current-year totals are partial, representing fiscal year to date activity. All figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. This record shows a rebound from FY25 and FY26 levels into FY27. Richard Group’s award-count and average-award-size indicate the company is capturing relatively few, higher-dollar awards this fiscal year rather than many small contracts. Readers should use the fiscal-year series to track how obligations have moved over time and to compare FY2027 to prior years on an apples-to-apples basis using obligations as the metric.

sections.heading: How has Richard Group’s federal business trended over recent years?
sections.body: Richard Group’s obligations declined from FY23 $265M to FY24 $151M and then to FY25 $34.1M, before rising to FY26 $48.3M and FY27 $65.4M. Richard Group’s FY2027 obligations are up 35.5% year over year compared with the prior fiscal year. Richard Group’s pattern shows a return toward higher obligation levels after the dip in FY25.
